name: Unit Or Face Amount Or Code 1 Choice
definition: Choice between a unit in decimal number, a face amount in currency and amount or a unit expressed as a code.

Unit.name: Unit
Unit.definition: Quantity expressed as a number, eg, a number of shares.

FaceAmount.name: Face Amount
FaceAmount.definition: Quantity expressed as an amount representing the face amount, ie, the principal, of a debt instrument.
